summary: Moved all rounding into meterbill/money.py (context-free, integer based), removed the decimal context line, and verified outputs match the original on samples and fuzzing. Preserved quirks: batch worker threads round band charges and per-kWh price half-even (they ran under the default context) while bill/quote/tariffs round half-up; payable for rule whole is unchanged. Not emulated: context precision rounding of >28-digit arithmetic.
